mobile_tablet.reuse: If the device works safely, consider continued use or responsible reuse.
mobile_tablet.repair: Seek a qualified technician for repair assessment.
mobile_tablet.recycle: If reuse or repair is not practical, use an authorised e-waste collection channel.
mobile_tablet.safety: If the battery is swollen, leaking or damaged, do not charge, use or dismantle the device. Seek professional handling.
mobile_tablet.data_protection: Back up important information and securely erase personal data before transferring or disposing of the device.

charger_adapter.reuse: Reuse only if the charger is in good condition and operates safely.
charger_adapter.repair: Seek a qualified technician if the charger is faulty.
charger_adapter.recycle: Use an authorised e-waste collection channel when it is no longer usable.
charger_adapter.safety: Stop using a visibly damaged charger. Disconnect it only if safe.

cable.reuse: Reuse if the cable is intact and works properly.
cable.repair: Replace or seek professional assessment if damaged.
cable.recycle: Send unusable cables to an authorised e-waste collection channel.
cable.safety: Do not use cables with exposed wires or damaged insulation.

circuit_board.reuse: Consider reuse only after qualified inspection.
circuit_board.recycle: Send unusable boards to an authorised e-waste recycler.
circuit_board.safety: Avoid touching exposed components or attempting unsafe dismantling.

computer_accessory.reuse: Reuse if the accessory works properly and is safe.
computer_accessory.repair: Seek professional repair assessment if faulty.
computer_accessory.recycle: Use an authorised e-waste collection channel if unusable.
computer_accessory.safety: Avoid using accessories with exposed wires or damaged electrical parts.

other_ewaste.reuse: Confirm the item type and condition before considering reuse.
other_ewaste.repair: Seek professional assessment if the item is faulty.
other_ewaste.recycle: Use an authorised e-waste collection channel.
other_ewaste.safety: Do not dismantle unknown electronic items. Seek professional guidance.
